title: A Smile for the Bell
author: Ines Marchetti
blurb: Emrys Lockridge, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
